Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, OcrConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="image/png", uri="https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png")
    config = ExtractionConfig(ocr=OcrConfig(backend="paddleocr", enabled=True, language=["en"], paddle_ocr_config={"language": "en", "model_tier": "mobile", "model_version": "pp-ocrv6"}))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
